description: `<program trusted-proxies="1">` — a quoted value. `trusted-proxies=` is a bare integer literal from 0 to 32; any other value is E-MW-009.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — the rest of S478 hand-off §3.B, PA recs adopted (S479, 2026-11-18)" item 6 (`<program trusted-proxies=N>`, default 0); E-MW-009 minted by lane s479-channel-follow
rationale: §40.2: the value is how many reverse proxies' forwarded headers the server trusts, so a value the compiler cannot read is refused (E-MW-009) rather than guessed — a guess either trusts a header the client wrote or ignores the proxy the author declared. impl#1 does not read `trusted-proxies=` (carried, g-impl1-xfwd-trusted-proxies-owed-s479).
